name: System

members.name: After

members.name: Enabled

members.name: Renderer
members.summary: Draws shapes, sprites, text and shader passes. Null when running headless.

members.name: Scene

members.name: Time

members.name: Controls

members.name: Inspector
members.summary: The Inspector owned by this scene, including its unavailable headless service.

members.name: RenderLayer
members.summary: The layer this system's `LateRender` draws on. Override to draw overlays or UI on top.

members.name: Dispose
members.summary: Runs when the system or scene shuts down. Release what `Initialize` created.
members.summaryText: Runs when the system or scene shuts down. Release what Initialize created.

members.name: FixedUpdate
members.summary: Runs 64 times per second. Put movement, physics and other simulation here.
members.summaryText: Runs 64 times per second. Put movement, physics and other simulation here.

members.name: Initialize
members.summary: Runs once when the scene starts. Create render targets and other resources here.
members.summaryText: Runs once when the scene starts. Create render targets and other resources here.

members.name: LateRender
members.summary: Runs every frame after all `Render` calls, ordered by `RenderLayer`. Draw overlays and UI here.
members.summaryText: Runs every frame after all Render calls, ordered by RenderLayer. Draw overlays and UI here.

members.name: OnResize
members.summary: Runs after the window size changes. Recreate size-dependent render targets here.
members.summaryText: Runs after the window size changes. Recreate size-dependent render targets here.

members.name: Render
members.summary: Runs every frame to produce images other systems may read, such as lighting buffers.

members.name: Update
members.summary: Runs every frame. Handle input presses and frame-rate-dependent work here.
